decision: Frozen after the one previously reviewed standing/walking development record and its existing simple baseline. No other participant header, signal, label or fitted result was opened by the modelling owner before this design.
source: Gracia Laso et al., Experiment 2, release 2, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19065545, CC BY 4.0. Source arrays stay private in this workflow. Previous qualification and controls e407da04c118e7a66c7b0e3cb0a5ad20a408035def02fa5072a908b3d631b7b4 (forecast-design.json).

split.procedure: Leave one development person out, including both trials, for each of four folds. Then fit all four for independent assessment. No hyperparameter selection in either stage.

support: Check 2000 Hz source metadata, continuous source time with 0.0005 s spacings (absolute tolerance 1e-10 s), four numbered orientation channels, 32 raw channels per voltage site and task code meanings. In each continuous 611 static or 621 motion basic-task block, cutoffs start at block_start+200 and advance by 200, with cutoff+200 strictly before exclusive block end. A complete valid history and finite nonzero target orientation is required. Report rejected nonfinite/zero-norm windows; stop if any person lacks either task, the common wrong-pair support, or a nominated trial. Never replace a person/trial. Offline acquisition clock is the source shared stored time axis. Orientation has an approximately 100 Hz internal update.
target: Unsigned device rotation in degrees from cutoff to cutoff+200. Normalize each orientation independently in float64. angle=2*180/pi*acos(clip(abs(dot),0,1)). No anatomical axes or angular direction inferred.

tokens.sequence: 10 chronological 20-gap bins. For bin j=1..10, end=start+20*j (start=cutoff-200); raw voltage uses exactly end-19 through end inclusive. Motion uses endpoints start, end-20, end. No interpolation, centered/acausal filtering, whole-record quality flags, future task or time index used as a feature.
tokens.columns: step_deg is unsigned bin-endpoint change. from_start_deg is unsigned change between history start and current bin end. walk is 1 for 621, 0 for 611. Each site's three features use natural log1p of (1) median across electrodes of temporal population SD, (2) median across electrodes of RMS successive difference across the 19 gaps, (3) temporal population SD of instantaneous across-electrode median. Operate on raw stored voltage numbers in publisher units; no anatomical source assignment. Shared order and weights used at every bin.

control: Within person, trial and same basic task, sort eligible cutoffs chronologically; rotate voltage donors by floor(n/2) on that list. Require disjoint closed donor and receiver [cutoff-200,cutoff+200] intervals. Fail admission on overlap or missing donor. Both sites and all 10 tokens travel together; recipient motion/task and scoring target stay fixed. Offline negative control may draw a temporally later unrelated donor; it is never a real-time predictor. This is distinct from a mask.
fit: All trainable predictors use only fitting people. Fit token column means and population SD over training windows and bins, weighted to equal people and tasks inside people. Leave task column unscaled, substitute SD=1 for SD<1e-8. Use z-scores clipped to [-8,8]. Motion/upper/lower/full model variants zero unavailable normalized voltage columns after scaling; all have identical capacity and initial weights. Task median is the unweighted empirical within-task training median. Ridge regresses future minus entire recent angle on flattened standardized step/from_start over 10 bins and one task flag, fitted with equal person/task total weights, unpenalized intercept and L2=0.01 on slopes for a mean squared objective. Zero predicts 0, constant speed predicts last 100ms unsigned net angle. Bound fitted forecasts to [0,180] degrees for scoring.

network.normalization: Post-residual layer norm, eps=1e-5, learned gain/bias. Linear input projection plus learned bin position, self-attention (full attention over already historical tokens), residual/norm, 2-layer ReLU feedforward, residual/norm. Last token readout predicts an additive residual in degrees on the last entire observed angle; no future or autoregressive tokens.
network.export: model.json contains config, feature_names, scaler (mean/scale), models {motion,upper,lower,full} of named nested row-major weight/bias arrays, baselines (task median and ridge), synthetic parity. PyTorch Linear uses y=x W^T+b. Predictions require raw tokens; physical skip is raw token[9][1]. Wrong uses full weights with wrong voltage inputs.
network.training: CPU float32 PyTorch deterministic seed 1941 for every fit, same shuffle and order across variants. AdamW lr=0.002, weight decay=0.01, batch size 96 including last, 18 epochs with no early stop, loss SmoothL1(beta=1 degree) on unclipped prediction, inverse relative person/task window count as multiplier. Fixed epoch 18. Training-only transformations; output clipping only for scores and public inference.

scoring: Mean absolute error in degrees per person and task after combining their two trials. Average the two task MAEs equally per person, then all people equally. Report mean movement and standing MAE separately. Supply paired person-level differences and full enumerated person bootstrap 95% percentile interval for the balanced difference (4^4 resamples in each four-person stage), descriptive only. No interval-level independence or external-population confidence claim.

decision_gates.electrode_increment: Full balanced MAE at least 5% below the best of zero, constant_speed, task_median, ridge_motion and motion; at least 2% below wrong; full beats motion AND wrong in each of at least 3/4 people, with no worse task mean for standing or movement versus motion and wrong. Report all component tests regardless. Development passing is descriptive; untouched assessment must pass independently to describe evidence of incremental electrode timing on that sample.
decision_gates.upper_specific: In a stage passing electrode_increment, full improves balanced MAE by >=2% vs lower, with strict improvement for at least 3/4 people.
decision_gates.lower_specific: In a stage passing electrode_increment, full improves balanced MAE by >=2% vs upper, with strict improvement for at least 3/4 people.
decision_gates.inference: Report a failed comparison explicitly. Motion artifact, muscle and cardiac contamination can contribute. A positive result would concern this device, protocol and finite known task codes; it does not isolate spinal neural signals or establish a generative movement model.

sealing: Publish immutable protocol digest before additional development access. Hash model JSON, prespecified transforms, score and inference code, and report before authorizing assessment. No modelling-owner access to assessment or reserve files. Independent assessment scorer uses frozen code. No raw participant windows in public products.
